experiment_data.hypothesis: W1 new model: Qwen2.5-14B hires bf16 2-bit-only profiling. 48L x 8KV (GQA 5:1), 384 heads. Same Qwen family as 7B (Spread, concentration=0.61) — tests whether diagnostic generalizes within model family at larger scale.
experiment_data.notes: Qwen2.5-14B (48L×8KV, GQA 5:1): Extreme Spike — t1/t5=24.35 (highest of all models). L0H5 delta=1.845 is 7.8× Top-2. L0 dominance 15.5x. L28 is secondary hotspot (3 heads in Top-10). CRITICAL FINDING: Qwen2.5-14B is Spike despite Qwen2.5-7B being Spread — same family, different scale, different shape. This challenges any simple architecture→shape mapping and strengthens the case for per-model profiling. Predicts: unconstrained MCKP safe (single dominant head easily handled by constraint), cardinality constraint mostly irrelevant (only 1 truly dangerous head).
